service.ur: تبدیل شدہ تفصیلات یا بھرے صفحات پر پاسپورٹ کی تبدیلی
service.ml: വിവരം മാറിയതിനോ പേജ് നിറഞ്ഞതിനോ പാസ്പോർട്ട് മാറ്റൽ

about: Replace a UAE passport because personal details changed or it has no free pages.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Photo change for changed looks is for applicants under 5
For full pages, show the passport to the Identity and Foreigners Affairs directorate in your emirate
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
